_comment: No PR is open for this branch, so step 1 is a hard stop and nothing past it
The `pr view` entry must stay FIRST and must fail the way real gh fails --
exit 1 with 'no pull requests found'. An earlier pass at tightening these
cassettes appended a generic `pr view --json statusCheckRollup` entry to every
fixture and let it shadow this one, so the trial got exit 0 and an empty
`{"statusCheckRollup": []}` back. That is not a 'no PR' answer, it is a PR with
no checks, and an agent keying off the exit code would have walked straight
into the loop. Hence no generic tail entries here: any other call means the
skill kept going after the stop, and the failing default should say so.
